eligibility_tiers.ypp_ads: Channel approved for the advertising/Premium tier; relevant modules and extra content requirements apply.
eligibility_tiers.expanded_ypp_feature: Channel accepted to expanded YPP and qualifies for the selected Commerce module and feature, including additional age and country restrictions.
eligibility_tiers.ypp_virtual_items: Channel accepted to YPP and the Virtual Items module, eligible country and content.
eligibility_tiers.shopping_own_eligibility: YPP or other applicable shopping eligibility, connected eligible store and valid merchandise.

pathways.name: Watch-page advertising
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel approved for the advertising/Premium tier; relevant modules and extra content requirements apply.
pathways.mechanism: Creator receives a contractual share of applicable net watch-page advertising revenue, not a flat fee per playback.
cost_drivers: fill rate and exclusions; cost of creating videos
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Shorts Feed advertising
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel approved for the advertising/Premium tier; relevant modules and extra content requirements apply.
pathways.mechanism: Creator's share applies after country-level pool allocation and eligible engaged-view attribution, not total raw Shorts views.
cost_drivers: advertiser demand and competing eligible creators
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: YouTube Premium allocation
pathways.revenue_basis: Share of relevant Premium subscription receipts
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel approved for the advertising/Premium tier; relevant modules and extra content requirements apply.
pathways.mechanism: The publisher receives a share when Premium viewers watch eligible content; the per-view rate is not universal.
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Channel memberships
pathways.revenue_basis: Recurring member payments and applicable net creator allocation
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel accepted to expanded YPP and qualifies for the selected Commerce module and feature, including additional age and country restrictions.
pathways.mechanism: Members pay monthly for creator-supplied perks; service and perk-delivery costs matter.
cost_drivers: taxes and eligibility; not suitable for every channel
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Super Chat and Super Stickers
pathways.revenue_basis: Eligible net viewer contributions subject to Commerce module
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel accepted to expanded YPP and qualifies for the selected Commerce module and feature, including additional age and country restrictions.
pathways.mechanism: Viewer contributions highlight live-chat content; features vary by location and content classification.
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Super Thanks
pathways.revenue_basis: Eligible net viewer contributions subject to Commerce module
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel accepted to expanded YPP and qualifies for the selected Commerce module and feature, including additional age and country restrictions.
pathways.mechanism: Viewer pays to highlight supportive engagement on eligible videos/Shorts.
cost_drivers: Availability and eligible video types; avoid treating likes as payments
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Live gifts, Jewels and Rubies
pathways.revenue_basis: Rubies earned on eligible live gifts
pathways.eligibility_description: Channel accepted to YPP and the Virtual Items module, eligible country and content.
pathways.mechanism: Current YouTube Help permits eligible vertical and horizontal livestream gifts; creator earns Rubies at USD 0.01 each under Virtual Items terms after viewers redeem Jewels. Do not infer the cash value of Jewel purchases.
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Shopping: own products
pathways.revenue_basis: Net merchant sales after storefront, fulfillment and other costs
pathways.eligibility_description: YPP or other applicable shopping eligibility, connected eligible store and valid merchandise.
pathways.mechanism: YouTube displays tagged products from an eligible connected storefront; actual sales and settlement follow retailer terms.
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

pathways.name: Shopping: affiliate products

pathways.eligibility_description: YPP member with sufficient subscriber threshold in an eligible location, permitted channel type and merchant offerings.
pathways.mechanism: Tag products from participating sellers and receive eligible commissions; the product commission rate is not fixed globally.
pathways.limitations: Actual eligibility, cash flow, payment terms and availability require checking for the creator's circumstances. Earnings and entry costs are not estimated.

measurement_rules: Count official features separately from external business monetization.
A registered account, eligible channel, approved YPP member, monetized video and paid creator are different populations.
Do not infer a stable percentage of gross advertising spending from a percentage of net allocated receipts.
Never treat affiliate sales, GMV or sponsor quotes as creator earnings.
Do not assume a future announced feature is available until its local live status is documented.
Not all monetization pathways can operate on child-directed content.
Unknown fees, earnings and conversions are null, never zero.

affiliate_settlement.rule: Never enter native shopping-affiliate commission in affiliate_cash_received as external bank cash when already included in platform_posted_net; recognize only cleared AdSense bank receipt in platform_bank_received.

accounting_nonadditivity.why: Channel total estimated revenue already includes applicable advertiser net allocations
Channel total estimated revenue already includes allocated Premium payments
Advertiser gross receipts and creator net advertising use different accounting bases and cannot be summed
Finalized platform accrual and its later deposited cash are separate balance movements, not two revenues
Native shopping-affiliate pay is in AdSense, not an external merchant affiliate receipt

possible_duplicate_underlying_transactio.needs: Prove merchant orders and commission contracts are separate
Prove brand integrations or invoices are separate
Prove product sale settlements are separate
Prove supporters' payments were not counted in both systems

constraints: Selections indicate hypothetical pathways to compare; no route is eligible, funded or approved merely because it is selected.
Watch-page ads, Shorts, Premium, memberships and fan payments have distinct units and product gates; do not add overlapping aggregate estimatedRevenue to its component reports.
Shopping affiliate uses AdSense for YouTube with 60–120-day purchase-to-payment schedule and reversals on returns, not direct cash from a merchant.
External affiliate contracts, owned products, off-site support and services have distinct processors and refund obligations.
Sponsor contracts facilitated by YouTube and independent sponsorships may represent the same brand invoice; prohibit double-counting absent invoice identifiers.
All amounts, taxes, rights deductions, channel eligibility, regions, bank receipts and labor remain unmeasured.
